h1.cap: Borrowed strength... always sends you a bill.

n2.cap: Machiavelli studied rulers who won with a borrowed army... then became its prisoner.

q1.cap: "For losing, one is undone, and winning, one is their captive."

n3.cap: He retells an old story. Young David offers to face a giant.

n4.cap: King Saul hands him his own armour. Heavy. Polished. Royal.

n5.cap: David takes it off. He can't use it. He walks out... with his sling.

n6.cap: Today, the armour is the friend who writes all your code... or the one client your shop can't lose.

q2.cap: "The arms of others either fall from your back, or they weigh you down, or they bind you fast."

n7.cap: That doesn't mean refuse all help. But the skill that saves you... must be yours.

n8.cap: Pick one job you always hand to someone else. Do it yourself, once, today.

n9.cap: What's your sling? Tell me in the comments.

n10.cap: Follow Awazzzz... and build your own strength.
